Weight: each piece is about 12-15 g, so 10 pieces come to roughly 130-150 g. I'll use 140 g.

Energy: cooked carrots are about 35-40 kcal per 100 g. The glaze adds butter or sugar, which raises that to roughly 60 kcal per 100 g. That gives about 85 kcal, so I'll round up to 90.
